# quaykit 4.1.0

This release adds per-worker rate limiting and introduces `timeoutMs` as the preferred job timeout option. The existing `timeout` option still works and logs a one-time deprecation warning.

## Features

- Add a per-worker token-bucket rate limiter configured with `limiter: { max, perMs }`. (#376)

## Deprecations

- Deprecate the job option `timeout` in favor of `timeoutMs`; both options work during the transition. (#378)
